notes.title: Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
Shareholders!

[b]Terrytorial Disputes is now Verified on the Steam Deck! [/b]

Gabe Newell has personally tested my game on the Steam Deck, and graced [i]Terrytorial Disputes[/i] with Verification! (joke)

One of my goals for [i]Terrytorial Disputes[/i] is to make it a fantastic bed-time gaming Tower Defense game, This verification is a huge step towards that.

There is an official config for the Steam Deck that has most features of the game bound to the controller's inputs. 

[b]RECOMMENDED:[/b]
- Disabled Edge Camera Panning 
- Switch to 2 Column sidebar
- Use the left track-pad Radial Menu for quick Structure Category Selection

If you have feedback or thoughts about how to make the Steam Deck version of TD better, feel free to discuss in the Steam Community or join the Discord!

Dividends soon,
Terry
- Terry @ Terryble Interactive

notes.title: Autumn Sale + Update V2.75: New Cutscenes, Purchase Tech In-Game.
notes.content:
[i]*This update is to the Default Branch, changes should be playable by all users at time of this post*[/i]

Gamers & Shareholders!

Autumn Sale is upon us, and I wanted to use this opportunity to release a new update along with the sale. If you're new to TD or a returning player, Welcome back General.

I'm excited for this update, the largest change is the ability to purchase Technologies after defeating one of the King's Champion enemies that are every 25 rounds. I genuinely feel like this update is another step forward towards refining the game play elements and formulas. 

I'm aiming for monthly update, but I believe the amount of content in this update will make up for the delay. I tried to grab significant changes to put in the change log, but I'm also not the best at writing down every change I make. A notable amount of time was also dedicated to making the experience on the Steam Deck even better. I recognize that the menu's weren't as controller friendly as they should be. Overall a lot of work on buttons, UI, menus that I believe will make the Steam Deck experience better.

There has also been a lot of work done these past two months on learning Blender, rigging vehicles, and just transferring assets; This will help by allowing me to make cut-scenes faster, ideally this will be work that I can pass on to animators in the future to make even more cut-scenes.

I want to thank LeckMich & KrayZee Toucan from the Discord for bug finding. I want to thank all others that have also helped by leaving comments on Discord or in the Steam Discussions

Dividends soon Shareholders,
Terry


[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Purchase Technology after defeating King's Champion enemies, 4 new KC's at Round 25, 75, 125, & 175
[*] I redrew the coasts & roads to be more in line with the art style I'm going for. 
[*] 3 NEW cut-scenes, fresh out of blender, still experimenting with them.
[*] New Intro video, it's implementation in-game is still a WIP.
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Re-balance of most of Tech 2 and 3, Cost & Power numbers aligned better.
[*] Rewrote the scroll functions of the list of cameos in the side bar, Unity's built in version is bad.
[*] Guard Tower detects both air and ground stealth targets, it took a bit of re-greasing, but the spotlight can now aim up.
[*] Disabled Airfield again, I promise this time.
[*] Fixed Technology for the Atomic Reactor.
[*] Fixed Configuration for Adv Power Booster
[*] V5's Target Tracking Technology now properly requires the player to be at Tech Tier 3.
[*] Projectile Based Turrets can now properly inflict stun, slow, and burn on enemy targets.
[*] Fixed any unlock tier config issues with walls
[*] Possible fix to 2 Columns Vs 3 Column modes resetting
[*] Fixed Several advancement misconfigurations (Thanks KrayZee Toucan)
[*] Removed Duplicate Sniper "Detect Camo" Technologies
[*] Nuclear Reactor should no longer be invisible after being fully constructed
[*] Reduced Minimum range for Gustav
[*] Added Minimum range for V7
[*] Turret's Current custom tracking mode isn't overwritten when it's stats get updated.
[*] You can no longer build non-water structure on water, and vice versa. 
[*] Fixed Advanced Gem Refinery's Range Increase upgrade works properly
[*] Turrets should stop firing when total power is Zero, just as research should be stopped.
[*] Possible fix to music hicups during higher lag situations.
[*] Fixed Z clippling between the pseudo-shadows under vehicles at high LOD levels with the road
[*] Juggernaut has been properly configured to tech tier 2, as opposed to 3
[*] Stealth Detecting turrets should now default back to aiming at Camo, This was broken after I disabled the "resetting" of tracking mode every time a turret stat's updated. I did a little duct tape solution that will just check if Stealth Turrets are stealth, and it'll force them into Stealth attack mode every update. I'm not proud of the current fix, but I think it'll hold until a re-write the whole turret system.
[*] MRLS's Tech tree isn't made up of Humvees anymore.
[*] Using the "Farthest" targeting mode on a Certain King Champions would result in it outpacing it's own range, and fail to fire, fixed that.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log & Update V2.21: New Enemies, Balance Changes, and Bugfixes!
notes.content:
[i]This update is to the Default Branch & Demo, changes should be playable by all users at time of this post[/i]

Shareholders!

I have pushed all of the changes and improvements from experimental to default, and additional hotfixes. I appreciate your patience as I figure out the exact balance of this game, I believe each update we are getting closer to a great balance baseline. I do recognize that as I add new units and status effects, they might take a couple of updates to perfectly find their home.

Management Terry has paid [i]McClancy & Company[/i] over $12 Million to consult us on improvements for the game. Upon much research the consultants reached the same conclusion that one of our low level programming Terries already knew; The Map generator is holding us back. Below is a cool dev diary showing off what I'm doing with the new map generator, and why I believe it's a foundational step into tower defense perfection:

[previewyoutube=518zG3F1F0s;full][/previewyoutube]

As always I'd love to hear your feedback!

Terry
-CEO, Terry, Possibly a corporation

[b]Changes Since Last Update To Default[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Paradox Rift effects, it's all GPU shader stuff so it shouldn't be noticeable on performance. 
[*] Stealth Enemies! 
[*] 		2 New Stealth Units.
[*] 		Guard Tower: reveals stealth units, and additional technologies added to towers to allow them to target stealth units.
[*] "Silos Needed" audio check will trigger every 15 seconds, it'll do this 3 times. It won't restart until silo capacity has dropped below 75%.
[*] Small Text on the first Tech Research slot to remind players to construct a tech uplink.
[*] Custom Death Gibs: I want to capture the General's technical exploding when units die style. I want a corpse of the vehicle to fly up, explosion, gibs, the whole style. I've been working on adding some to the earlier vehicles. (Like always this was 100x harder than initially imagined)
[*] Status Effects are now label on Champion's Health Bar, they can be hovered over with the mouse to reveal the description!
[*] Champion's Name can now be pulled from your Steam Friends List!
[*] Pause screen now includes me begging for reviews.
[*] Invincible Status Effect
[*] Steam Rich Presence Text for In-game status, now your friends can actively judge your performance.
[*] DX11 Launch Option: If you are having crashing issues, please attempt this mode.
[/list]



[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Not all Exit To Desktop Buttons were created equal, If you died and exited to desktop, you were still prompted to give feedback. I thought that was disabled... BUT, I do have ~80 responses, so that'll be a great resource. *Feedback Survey Removed*
[*] Console should now prevent keyboard inputs from registering.
[*] Tactical Center Damage done by enemy units is now based only on difficulty & the vehicle's base stat. Being a Champion doesn't give it bonus damage.
[*] Temporarily disabled Airfield, it will be returned better than ever, its really old, buggy, and bare-bones. I intend to rewrite it with more features soon.
[*] Attempted To fix the the inability to place tech structures, I still haven't been able to nail down what exactly is causing it.
[*] Gem Refineries no longer believe that water nodes are interact-able.
[*] Basic Power Plant default power generation 100 -> 150 
[*] Higher EXP gain at higher rounds.
[*] Tons of minor configuration changes.
[*] Continued work in reducing mesh count & adding Level Of Detail models to every model.
[*] Main menu camera sped up
[*] Feedback button now closes with settings menu
[*] H Key now returns you to your HQ as intended
[*] Redid Terry-Gear MK1, It looks weaker and more unique now, feels more like a MK1.
[*] Reworked Terry-Gear MK2, It shoots a conventional cannon now, and it's stats re-balanced.
[*] Small Game-pad UI interaction fixes
[*] Finally managed to center the Technology Shop camera...
[*] Mission Success screen should display upon surviving round 250.
[*] Reduced construction time of Atomic & Nuclear reactors.
[*] UI fixes for Widescreen users
[/list]


[b]Tech Tree Moves:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed a bunch of technologies that felt like useless, Example: Basic Power Plant now only has 2 upgrade technologies
[*] Gem Refinery tech moved to Tier 1
[*] Power Structure health up moved to Tier 1
[*] All Walls are pushed up a tier, Concrete walls now starts at tier 1
[/list]

notes.title: [Dev Beta] Update V2.17: New Enemies, Balance Changes, New Logo, and Bugfixes!
notes.content:
[i]As a Dev Beta, this build is currently accessible in the experimental branch[/i]

Gamers!

I want to thank everyone who bought Terrytorial Disputes, as of this update we are slightly above 500 units sold! I've received a ton of feedback, I want to especially thank the 80 people who did the survey. It's all been read and organized, a lot of it will go into future systems and changes, but there were changes that could be done quickly. 

I've been working on the new version of the map generator, the current map generator is the oldest part of the game. The scope and features that I need out of the map has vastly outgrown the current system. I don't want to release a lot of information about it since a lot of features are in the works, but I honestly believe it'll be a great addition to the final vision I have for Terrytorial Disputes.

I appreciate your patience as I figure out the exact balance of this game, I believe each update we are getting closer to a great balance baseline. I do recognize that as I add new units and status effects, they might take a couple of updates to perfectly find their home.

New Logo: Our Benefactors at ClancyWorks (A subsidiary of TerTech Interplanetary) have graciously bestowed upon us a refresh of the logo. While the original logo has served as this game's honorable symbol during it's development, it is time for *Expand & Exterminate: Terrytorial Disputes - Endless Base Defense* to molt It's chrysalis and be reborn as a butterfly. I believe the new logo looks great, and is a fantastic step into helping establish *Terrytorial Disputes* as the gleaming-gold standard to which with all future tower defense, and terry-type games will be compared to. 

I'm excited to continue working on the game, I have a lot of big plans and ideas cooking up! Please join me on Discord, or any other of my social medias to stay up to date!

notes.title: First Update! V1.90
notes.content:
Gamers!

I'm excited to release the first batch of fixes and updates, just trying to keep polishing and fixing before adding new content. notes.title: Early Access Release! Terrytorial Disputes is avaliable!
notes.content:
Gamers, Terry Here, it is with great excitement that I announce that Terrytorial Disputes is now available for purchase! 

Terrytorial Disputes has exceeded my wildest expectations since I started working on it a year and a half ago. In my eyes, TD is just beginning; the systems are stable and ready to be filled with content. The past year and a half has merely been the tutorial level, the warm-up; the real race starts now. We have just made it to the starting line.

I look at the code that I wrote for this game at the start and it's incredible how much I've learned since, and I am more than ever aware of how much I really have left to learn about being a developer. From writing the code, testing, marketing, UI design, game design, and balance. These is so much to do, but such a beauty to watching everything come together.

I'm consciously trying to avoid writing a classic Terry overly verbose wall of text, so... Terrytorial Disputes is Terry, and Terry is me. This game is, at the end of the day, a reflection of my inner childhood and my personal tastes in video games and media. It's my vision realized in a specific package. I feel like a parent, fearing if I've truly done enough to prepare my child for the real world. But the time is now, and the only way the game and I can grow is through your feedback.

I look forward to hearing your feedback and continuing to improve the game!

Thank you,
Terry


Day 0 Update:
June 14th - June 26th, 2023
V1.9

Added:
-Enemies now have the ability to store up to 4 weapon slots with their respective stats & ID. BEEG multi-weapon enemies *soon*.
-Steam Stats?! I added a basic implementation of Steamwork's stats to capture the 3 most "important" stats: 
	[list]
[*] Total Enemies Killed, Total Funds Generated, Total Chunks Generated
[*] 	This'll be aggregated across everyone, I hope this will provide some cool numbers.
[*] 	I intend to research how to set up the steam leader boards in a future update.
[/list]
-A check to prevent double expansion, should prevent 2 chunks from spawning in low frame rate situations


Fixed:
[list]
[*] Added Static meshes for the Vic Depots, and replaced the door animator with a some Lean Tweens. Performance.
[*] First chunk should now be a regular straight chunk, this is to prevent water or complex chunks from spawning.
[*] Reduced Damage & Range of the Bomb Carrier's self-destruct explosion.
[*] Power-Booster should work now as intended, We taught Terry basic math again.
[*] Bug where the Card Shop would display only the hidden icons, even if the technology was purchased.
[*] Changed how the the white repair "blink" is coded, now it should be a tiny bit more performant, and ideally not get stuck in white.
[*] Iron Walls should now block projectiles as intended
[*] Innumerable changes to stats in Turrets, Structures, and Technology. I am content with the current balance.
[*] Tech Tree Fixed for the 5th time, I believe that the act of creating a new scriptable object to hold the technologies caused the technology's UIDs to get reset as opposed to directly copied. My theory & testing shows that switching to instantiating the tree is more reliable.
        This caused the Tech Tree to have to be fully wiped and reset, this will be ideally the last and only time this has to be done.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility & Performance Update!
notes.content:
Gamers,

Terry here, I'm so excited to announce and release the Steam Deck compatibility "Update".
A lot of the features to become Steam Deck Verified have been slowly introduced in the last couple months. My goal is to maintain compatibility with the Steam Deck going forward, I believe the game is a blast with the Steam Deck, and I believe performance and usability are at a good spot where I'd love to hear feedback & ideas on how the experience on the deck can be improved. Control during the shops or menus should work, but the touchscreen and joysticks should always work in case of errors.

[b]RECOMMENDED:
Disabled Edge Camera Panning & Switch to 2 Column sidebar for best usability experience. [/b]

It's using two action-sets; one for In-Game and one for Menus.

Why Terrytorial Disputes is great on Deck:
[list]
[*] Converted Cutscene(s) to Webm VP8, this will make cutscenes compatible with the Steam Deck & Most future devices/platforms. Conversion reduces cutscene size by over 50%, 17MB vs 6.5MB.
[*] Vulkan Graphics API improve performance on AMD GPUs, Including the Steam Deck.
[*] Rescaled Text + UI Buttons to be more accessible for the Deck's Resolution.
[*] Custom In-Game controller Scheme: I've mapped almost every button on the Steam Deck to all of the feature in the game, from hitting "Select" to go back Home or using the D-pad to change the in-game speed.
[/list]

I'll be in bed playing TD on my Steam Deck,
Terry

notes.title: Update: Balance, UI, and Steam Deck Improvements.
notes.content:
Gamers, 

Terry Here, I got my hands on a Steam Deck, spent the majority of this week working on changes to the balance, rebuilding all the tech tiers, and optimizations for the Steam Deck.
This isn't *THE* Steam Deck update as I'm still working on getting the controller config off the deck and on to my PC, but it's being worked on. The game is a blast on the Deck, I've added inputs for the Time Scale buttons, Repair/Sell/Advance buttons, and 6 building categories, so that they can be configured to buttons on the Deck. I've added Vulkan API options specifically for the Steam Deck. 6 New Turrets, 1 New Structure. 


[list]
[b]Added:[/b]
[*] Fully converted to Unity's "New" input system, ironing out the bugs for full controller support, this is also step towards re-bindable keys.
[*] Little function that'll dynamically adjust the Camera's Render Width so that objects under the right hand UI bar are not rendered; Depending on the Gamer's monitor aspect ratio, the render width is changed to ensure there is no void space or rendering of the game under the sidebar.
[*] Enabled Vulkan API for MAXIMUM SteamDeck performance & "Longevity" (that's what the steam documentation says)
[*] Minimum Range settings for Turrets, I bet you won't guess which of the new turret this was used on.
[*] ~55 new technologies for said new buildings 
[*] Blast Radius debug option in setting menu, this way you can verify what the blast radius' size actually looks like.

[b]New Buildings:[/b]
[*] Grenade Launcher
[*] Juggernaut
[*] Prism Turret
[*] Mortar
[*] Artillery
[*] Gustav Cannon
[*] Vehicle Depot with MRLS systems (the hover variant)

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[*] Updated all the Difficulties, the top and bottom end for difficulty have been made more extreme.
[*] Increased interact-able "zone" for almost all of the UI buttons & menus
[*] Re-scaling a lot of text & UI to improve legibility on Steam Deck, I would love to hear feedback on how the scaling feels on the deck.
[*] Changed how the lines for the tech tree are drawn
[*] Reworked all the tech tiers and technologies, I'm still working on getting the pacing right, but I think this is a step in the right direction.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Update to V1.40.
notes.content:
Hello Generals,

We have a cornucopia of bug fixes and balances changes thanks to the kind folks that are giving feedback, I appreciate it a ton! A heck of a change-list considering it's a minor update, a ton of small undocumented changes to enemy & turret stats. I'd love to hear more feedback about the balance, it's tough for me to really experience the game from a fresh player's eyes, so I have a hard time balancing for new players.

Thanks Again,
Terry

Added:
[list]
[*] You can now manually tell a turret to fire at specific enemy units. This should help you generals clear any pesky aggressive enemies.
[*] Self Repair Technology added to the Tactical Center, it'll be interesting to see how this affects game play, I intend to give higher Tech Tier walls this technology as well in the future.
[/list]

Fixed:
[list]
[*] Falcon Helicopter's behavior was updated to be more in-line with the current system of detecting enemies. It should now be more consistent and reliable, but also a tiny bit more performant.
[*] Re-categorized some technology to fix tier issues.
[*] Rewritten the system that is used to store what technologies you have purchased across your sessions, should be resistant to errors due to changes cause index shifts in the tech tree.
[*] Floating Double Cannon when it was at half health or below.
[*] Lives UI now uses proper string formatting for the health pool.
[*] Vehicle Depots should now more reliably restart spawning units when the units that were spawned die.
[*] Vehicle Depots can be targeted by enemies again, tag config issue.
[*] Enemies spawned from the death of a "Spawner" enemy no longer start from waypoint 0.
[*] Map Generator is now more generous with it's ore fields at the start, hopefully this will prevent early game money drought.
[*] Rewrote the Power Plant System to Version [b]2[/b], which makes them behave better with power booster structures. This should also make all the numbers for power generation and consumption line up with in-game values.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest is live & Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

Massive update drop, Rebuilt a ton of systems based off of previous player feedback, and now I'm ready for feedback once again.

There are a ton of minor changes, but I'll the biggest changes:
-Ton of Performance & Optimization work, LOD and material changes.
-3 New turrets/structures
-15 new vehicle models.
-Dozens of new technologies
-New Map generator Chunks, Performance work, and Gem generation consistency.
-New effects & explosions
-New UI work
-4 new enemy status effects (Slow, Stun, Fire, and Dodge)


I've been working non-stop for a couple months now on this build, I believe all of the major bugs have been taken care of, I am focusing on balancing and getting all of the numbers to work together.

I am excited to get this build into your hands, please let me know what you think, your constructive criticism is always appreciated.

Good luck, General
-Terry

notes.title: Store is Live! - Demo V1.11 Build
notes.content:
Steam page and Demo are both live! 
Please Wishlist & Share!

Added:
-Unique voice line when your tactical center is under attack
-Loading screen that plays a little cutscene, I only have one cutscene made so far, but I like it.
-Feedback/Report button in-game so users can submit bugs and other reports directly through unity.
-Box Select and Pointer Select cursors should now appear for structures and UI you can interact with respectively.
-Basic Steamworks integration.


Changed:
-Rewrote the part of the map generator that deals with recursion. Recursive portals should be less likely to spawn on top of existing terrain, and also properly generate cliffs around the portal.
-Research Slot now appears after Tech structure has finished being constructed
-More model optimizations
-All the category buttons now blink when a new structure has been unlocked in that category
-Changed the ore generation script a bit to prevent it from giving player funds over capacity
-Fixed/Adjusted hitboxes on Refineries, Javelins, CWIS, Cannon, and Vantage; This should mitigate the issue with them being immune to rockets
-Adjusted the health bar size and position of all vehicles to be a bit more consistent.
-Fixed where the Health Bar for the Tactical Center would display the last health before the structure was destroyed, it should now show zero.
